target: forge.sh — reads ./.env itself: sources no other library, and works when it is the only file present (tracker.sh only sources obs.sh)
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_remote https://gitlab.example.test/grp/proj.git
if [[ -f "$F" ]]; then echo "sourced_libs=$(grep -cE '^[[:space:]]*(source|\.)[[:space:]].*(common|obs|tracker|workflow)\.sh' "$F")"; fi
mkdir -p iso/scripts/lib; cp "$F" iso/scripts/lib/forge.sh 2>/dev/null
F="$PWD/iso/scripts/lib/forge.sh"
printf 'FORGE_TOKEN=glpat-FAKE-not-a-real-token-0007\n' > .env
fx_http "GET /api/v4/projects/grp%2Fproj/merge_requests/7" 200 '{"state":"merged"}'
fx_run pr-state https://gitlab.example.test/grp/proj/-/merge_requests/7
echo "iso_out=$FX_OUT"
echo "iso_auth=$(tail -1 "$FORGE_MOCK_DIR/requests.log" 2>/dev/null | grep -o 'auth=[a-z]*' | cut -d= -f2)"
fx_done
